create_reformer_tokenizer: create a ReformerTokenizer instance with a SentencePiece vocab file for BPE tokenization
build_tokenizer_custom_vocab: build a ReformerTokenizer with custom vocabulary dictionary and merges list instead of loading from file
configure_special_tokens: configure ReformerTokenizer with custom eos_token, unk_token, pad_token, and additional_special_tokens
setup_metaspace_normalizer: setup ReformerTokenizer with Metaspace pre_tokenizer and decoder using SPIECE_UNDERLINE replacement
initialize_bpe_tokenizer: initialize a BPE-backed ReformerTokenizer with fuse_unk and byte_fallback settings
